Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Initial project structure for Medicaid Provider Spending database and dashboard

Sets up repo with README, .gitignore, .env.example, requirements.txt,
and empty directory structure for db/, etl/, app/, scripts/, and tests/.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add database schema, materialized views, and initial migration

- db/schema.sql: Core tables \(providers, addresses, taxonomies, hcpcs_codes, spending\)
- db/materialized_views.sql: Dashboard performance views \(provider summary, monthly, state, HCPCS\)
- db/migrations/001_initial.sql: Combined migration with IF NOT EXISTS guards
- scripts/setup_local.sh: Local PostgreSQL setup script

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
